authority.publishable_note: This is Runner's own wagering record on a third-party platform. It is NOT verified, NOT independently audited, and NOT a Runner model result. Do not publish as a performance claim without the reconciliation and disclosure items listed under open_questions.

open_questions: The two windows disagree sharply: 23% win rate over 12 months versus 13-6 (68%) over 30 days. Since 13 of roughly 22 total wins fall in the last month, the prior 11 months imply about 9 wins in 75 bets (~12%). Confirm whether the 12-month figure is win rate or ROI before either number is shown anywhere.
A 23% win rate returning positive profit implies heavy plus-money selections. Average odds and stake sizing are needed before profit is meaningful.
$693.84 profit in 30 days against $76.34 across 12 months means the trailing 11 months were roughly -$617. A 30-day figure shown alone would misrepresent the record.
Confirm whether these are real-money graded wagers, and whether the single connected book covers all activity.

Publishing wagering performance on a paid subscription site is a marketing claim. Runner's own reference audit states that no performance statistics establish Runner accuracy. Legal review of claim wording, sample disclosure and jurisdiction is required first.
boundary: BettingPros is a reference and inspiration target, not a data source. This record contains only Runner's own account figures. No BettingPros projection, rating, consensus or other proprietary computation is stored here or ingested anywhere in this repository.
